scientific_integrity: The claim is a finite-dimensional absolute linear projection constant, calculated by exact path-flow and dual operator identities; the finite rational checker and LP examples supplement rather than replace the proof. The known all-length-two diamond special case is not asserted as new.
scientific_limitations: Real, unweighted simple theta graphs with p>=2 equal a-edge paths and one b-edge path, a,b>=2; no arbitrary path lengths, weights, complex scalars, nonlinear projections, or independent historical priority certification.
title: Exact projection constants of one-defect theta-graph Lipschitz spaces
